detections.mission_name: Inventory SKU Turn Rate & Top Movers
detections.sql:
SELECT p.sku, p.style_name, SUM(se.units_sold) AS total_units_sold 
FROM sales_events se 
JOIN products p ON se.sku = p.sku 
GROUP BY p.sku, p.style_name 
ORDER BY total_units_sold DESC;
detections.insight: Our analysis reveals that the top-selling products in the operations domain are primarily consumable goods such as Oil, Biscuits, and Milk, indicating a strong demand for essential items. The top-selling non-consumable goods are Earphones and Power Bank, suggesting a growing need for personal electronics. Overall, the data suggests a focus on replenishing stock of essential items and exploring opportunities to expand the product portfolio in the electronics segment.
detections.recommendation: To optimize inventory management and improve customer satisfaction, we recommend implementing a just-in-time (JIT) inventory replenishment strategy for top-selling consumable goods. Additionally, we suggest conducting market research to identify opportunities to expand our product offerings in the electronics segment, particularly in the areas of personal electronics and accessories.
